caveat: Like-for-like replacement of existing roofing on a single-family dwelling costing $40,000 or less does not require a building permit under N.C.G.S. 160D-1110(c) (addition of roofing is carved in; replacement is carved out). NC OSFM guidance (10/19/2023) reads the exemption as replacement of roofing plus up to 15% of existing roof deck. A permit is still required if cost exceeds $40,000, load-bearing structure is added/repaired/replaced beyond that deck allowance, or new roofing is added. If a permit is issued, LUESA Section II.A applies ($59.70 + $12.19/$1,000 over $3,000) plus a $3 technology charge.

calculationNote: Low 2-ton $22 → min $60. Typical 3-ton $33+$22=$55 → $60. High 5-ton + furnace + ducts $55+$22+$17=$94.

extras.name: More-than-one-inspection accessory (typical)
extras.note: BID min $112.50 + DS min $37.50 + C&D $25. Included.

sourceName: City of Jacksonville §320.409(2) residential accessory-structure exceptions
caveat: 320 sf exceeds the 150 sf / $5,000 one-inspection accessory path. Low uses the one-inspection accessory bundle. Typical/high use the more-than-one-inspection accessory mins. Landscape fee exempt for SFR accessory on this exception. Florida 2.5% not on the COJ table.
calculationNote: Low one-inspection accessory: $75 (includes plan review) + DS $25 + C&D $25 = $125. Typical/high more than one inspection: BID $112.50 + DS $37.50 + C&D $25 = $175.

sourceName: City of Jacksonville §320.409(6) Alterations, Tenant Build-Out, Converting Use
caveat: Cabinets-only may be exempt. Totals are the alteration building path; separate electrical/plumbing/mechanical minimums are extra. Florida 2.5% is not itemized on the COJ fee page and is not added.

extras.name: Roof, Siding, Windows, and Doors (1 inspection)

sourceName: Columbus BZS 2026 Combined Development Related Fee Schedule — 1, 2, and 3 Family
caveat: Covering-only reroof is the combined roof/siding/windows/doors line. Structural roof work may be billed as Alterations/Accessory $385. Ohio 1% OBBS surcharge is not printed on the city PDF and is not added.
calculationNote: Flat $140 at $8k/$12k/$22k (was $125 on the June 1, 2025 schedule).

extras.name: Minor Work Permit (1 inspection)
extras.note: Low, only if the job is on the Approved Minor Work Permit List.

sourceName: Columbus BZS 2026 Combined Development Related Fee Schedule
caveat: C.C. 4113.63 requires a warm-air heating/ventilation permit to replace a heating unit. Like-for-like 3-ton uses the MEP $275 line unless listed as minor work.

sourceName: Columbus BZS 2026 Combined Development Related Fee Schedule
caveat: Typical 16×20 deck uses the 1-2-3 family Deck line. Multi-family deck is a different table.

sourceName: Columbus BZS 2026 Combined Development Related Fee Schedule
caveat: Cabinets-only with no MEP can be alterations $385. Typical kitchen stacks electrical + plumbing. Ohio 1% not on the PDF.

extras.name: If exemption fails: Class 2 remodel ≤1,000 sf $200 + application $40 + remodel plan review $150
extras.note: Not in totals. Structural/rafter/heavier covering path.

sourceName: Indianapolis Revised Code §536-201(b)(2) as amended by Proposal 239, 2025
caveat: Like-kind replacement of an existing roof by a listed contractor (or qualifying owner-occupant) is permit-exempt if no change in roof configuration, no heavier covering, no replacement of basic structural members (e.g. rafter or >128 sf of decking), and no heat-applied roofing.

extras.name: Additional $23 per 1,000 sf over 2,500 sf
extras.note: High assumes 2,501–3,500 sf house. Included in high only.

sourceName: Indianapolis DBNS craft fees / Revised Code §536-606 (unchanged Jan 5, 2026)
caveat: No application fee on craft permits after the Jan 5, 2026 notice. Duct extension only is exempt (§536-201(b)(24)). House sf is not in this dataset; high uses one extra 1,000 sf step.

sourceName: Indianapolis Revised Code §536-201(b)(15) and accessory Class 2 fees (Proposal 239, 2025)
caveat: Exempt if no part of the floor is more than 30 inches above finished grade and assessor notice 536-215 is filed. Typical 16×20 dataset deck is treated as >30 in.

sourceName: Indianapolis Revised Code §536-603 / §536-620 and craft plumbing/electrical tables
caveat: 200 sf typical kitchen is inside the ≤1,000 sf band. Same-layout cabinets with no E/P/H may be ordinary maintenance (536-201).

sourceName: City of Sacramento CDD-0245 Fees and Charges Collected on Residential Building Permits, revised 07-12-2026
caveat: City of Sacramento, not the county. Fire inspection $0.11/sf min $294 is for new area, not applied to reroof. City business operations tax 0.0004×val if contractor is the applicant is extra.

extras.name: Green Building min $1
extras.note: Included. SMIP is listed on the reroof path; HVAC change-out page does not list SMIP — not added.

sourceName: City of Sacramento CDD-0245 (HVAC and Re-roof $175)
caveat: Like-for-like 3-ton uses the $175 HVAC specific-cost permit, not the valuation table.

sourceName: City of Sacramento CDD-0245 residential valuation table
caveat: Open decks use the valuation table (ICC patio $34.50/sf × 320 sf = $11,040 would apply only if higher than contract). Typical uses assumed $12,000.

sourceName: City of Sacramento CDD-0245 residential valuation table
caveat: Non-structural single-fixture kitchen is a cheaper OTC path not used here. Cabinets-only may be exempt.

sourceName: KCMO Building Code §18-16 exempt work and §18-20(b)(2) 1-2 family fees (official code PDF 14842)
caveat: KCMO (Jackson County), not Kansas City, Kansas. Official exempt-work text: reroofing (replacement of roof coverings) of 1-2 family with light roof covering is exempt; the exemption does not include replacement of roof sheathing/deck or structural modifications.

extras.name: One- and two-family combined building/MEP permit §18-20
extras.note: At $7,500. Included. Optional express review $30 not included.

sourceName: KCMO Building Code §18-20 one- and two-family detached dwelling permit fees
caveat: Combined building/mechanical/plumbing/electrical fee for 1-2 family, not a separate HVAC flat.

sourceName: KCMO Building Code §18-20
caveat: Platforms ≤30 in above grade may be exempt under §18-16; typical 16×20 dataset deck is treated as permitted.

extras.name: §18-20 1-2 family combined permit (building+MEP)
extras.note: At $35,000. Included. 50% construction-document review applies to other-than-1-2-family, not this path.

sourceName: KCMO Building Code §18-20
caveat: Same-layout cabinets with no MEP may be exempt finish work. Dataset kitchens assume a permitted remodel.

extras.name: Building/residential permit $2,001–$25,000
extras.note: $271.43 + $34.09 × 10 at $12,000. 35% plan-review is a deposit credited to the permit, not an add-on.

sourceName: City of Detroit BSEED Fee Schedule, effective Jan 1, 2024, modified July 18, 2025 — Building and Residential Permits
caveat: No like-kind reroof exemption found in this schedule. Project cost uses the published square-foot cost table or contract.

extras.name: Electrical A4 ¼–10 HP/kW
extras.note: High path if a new circuit is inspected. Included in high only.

sourceName: Detroit BSEED Fee Schedule — gas-fired installation permits and refrigerating systems
caveat: HVAC is not the building valuation table. 2-ton through 5-ton furnaces stay in the ≤500,000 BTU tier. New-duct $200 is extra if ducts are replaced.

extras.name: Building/residential permit
extras.note: Same valuation table as reroof at $12,000. Included.

sourceName: Detroit BSEED Fee Schedule — New Buildings, Alterations, Repairs, And Additions
caveat: No deck-height exemption in the BSEED fee PDF. Typical 16×20 uses assumed $12,000.

extras.name: Electrical + plumbing plan review 7% each
extras.note: When those disciplines are reviewed. Included in typical/high.

sourceName: Detroit BSEED Fee Schedule — building permits and E/M/P 7% plan review
caveat: 35% building plan-review is a deposit toward the permit, not added. If E/P plan review is not required, drop the 14%. Cabinets-only may not need this path.
